# vengtoo_group_parent (Resource)

Makes one group inherit from another, so the child group picks up the parent's roles and policies. The hierarchy is a DAG — an edge that would create a cycle is rejected.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Child group, which inherits from the parent.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent group, whose roles and policies are inherited.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: group_id:parent_id
